name: Trade Transaction Condition 1 Code
definition: Indicates the conditions under which the order/trade is to be/was executed.

CBNS.name: Cum Bonus
CBNS.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed cum bonus.

XBNS.name: Ex Bonus
XBNS.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed ex bonus.

CCPN.name: Cum Coupon
CCPN.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed cum coupon.

XCPN.name: Ex Coupon
XCPN.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed ex coupon.

CDIV.name: Cum Dividend
CDIV.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed cum dividend.

XDIV.name: Ex Dividend
XDIV.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed ex dividend.

CRTS.name: Cum Rights
CRTS.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed cum rights.

XRTS.name: Ex Rights
XRTS.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed ex rights.

CWAR.name: Cum Warrant
CWAR.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed cum warrant.

XWAR.name: Ex Warrant
XWAR.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed ex warrant.

SPCU.name: Special Cum Dividend
SPCU.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed with a special cum |dividend, that is, buying after the ex date and getting the dividend.

SPEX.name: Special Ex Dividend
SPEX.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed with a special ex |dividend, that is, selling before the ex date without the coupon.

DUEB.name: Broker Due Bill
DUEB.definition: Indicates that the trade is executed cum-dividend or cum-coupon and a due bill is required. |A due bill is a contractual agreement to pay the dividend along with the delivery of |the financial instrument.

SSTI.name: Sold Short
SSTI.definition: Indicates whether the trade is sold short. When the seller does not have the |financial instrument, the delivery is effected by borrowing the financial instrument by or |for the account of the seller.

DIRT.name: Dirty
DIRT.definition: Indicates that the trade is executed dirty, ie government tax must be paid on the accrued interest on the bond.

CLEN.name: Clean
CLEN.definition: Indicates that the trade is executed clean, ie government tax must not be paid on the accrued interest on the bond.

BLKO.name: Block
BLKO.definition: Indicates whether the trade is a block trade or not, ie, whether allocation instruction will follow or not.

GTDL.name: Guaranteed Delivery
GTDL.definition: Indicates whether the delivery of the financial instrument on settlement date |is guaranteed.

FRAC.name: Fractions
FRAC.definition: Indicates whether fractional parts are allowed.

CRST.name: Cross Trade
CRST.definition: Indicates that cross trades are allowed whereby buy and sell orders are offset without recording the trade on the exchange.

NCRS.name: No Cross Trade
NCRS.definition: Indicates that cross trades, whereby buy and sell orders are offset without recording the trade on the exchange, are not allowed.

DORD.name: Direct Order
DORD.definition: Indicates that the order is to be executed by a trading party other than the trading party to which the |order is sent. In this case, the instructing party has traded with another broker which will |subsequently send an advice of execution to the executing party who received the order |and which is acting as clearing broker.

DIOR.name: Directed Order
DIOR.definition: Indicates that the order must be executed with a specific trading party.

DNIN.name: Not Increase
DNIN.definition: A limit order to buy or a stop order to sell or a stop limit order which is not to be increased in shares on the ex-dividend date as a result of a stock dividend or distribution.

DNRE.name: Not Reduce
DNRE.definition: A limit order to buy or a stop order to sell, or a stop-limit order to sell which is not to be reduced in price by the amount of an ordinary cash dividend. Only applies to ordinary stock dividends; it should be reduced for other distributions. e.g. when a stock goes 'ex' stock dividend or rights.

FORW.name: Forward Price Trade
FORW.definition: Indicates that the order is based on a forward price.

HIST.name: Historic Price Trade
HIST.definition: Indicates that the order is based on a historic price.

BCRO.name: Result Option
BCRO.definition: Result of option when set. (UK specific).

BCRP.name: Result Repo
BCRP.definition: Result of repo when set (UK specific).

BCPD.name: Deliver Country Incorporation
BCPD.definition: Place of delivery, in country of incorporation when unset (UK specific).

BCFD.name: Delivery Form
BCFD.definition: Form of delivery, not for foreign registration when unset (UK specific).

BCBL.name: Board Lot
BCBL.definition: Board lots, not set for odd lots (UK specific).

BCBN.name: Bad Name
BCBN.definition: Bad names, not set for good names (UK specific).

BTEX.name: Best Execution
BTEX.definition: Trade to be executed done at best execution.

CALL.name: Call
CALL.definition: Trade to be executed following the exercise of a call option on the security.

CLBR.name: Closure Before Roll Over
CLBR.definition: Trade to be executed for closure of a previous position before the rollover of a position (Deferred Settlement Service).

MONT.name: Monthly
MONT.definition: Trade to be executed for month-end settlement (Deferred Settlement Service).

NBFR.name: New Trade Following Rollover
NBFR.definition: Trade to be executed for a new trade position on the next month following the roll-over of a position (Deferred Settlement Service).

TRFR.name: Trade Following Rollover
TRFR.definition: Trade to be executed on the next month following the roll-over of positions.

PUTT.name: Putt
PUTT.definition: Trade to be executed following the exercise of a put option on the security.

SPCC.name: Special Cum Coupon
SPCC.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed with a special cum coupon.

SECN.name: Special Ex Coupon
SECN.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed with a special ex coupon.

SEBN.name: Special Ex Bonus
SEBN.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed special ex bonus.

SCBN.name: Special Cum Bonus
SCBN.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed special cum bonus.

SCRT.name: Special Cum Rights
SCRT.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed special cum rights.

SERT.name: Special Ex Rights
SERT.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed special ex rights.

SCCR.name: Special Cum Capital Repayments
SCCR.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed special cum capital repayments.

SECR.name: Special Ex Capital Repayments
SECR.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed special ex capital repayments.

CAST.name: Cash Settlement
CAST.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed with a cash settlement.

SPPR.name: Special Price
SPPR.definition: Indicates whether the trade is executed with a special price.
